issues.before: The matching button returned HTTP 501 on every request.
issues.cause: The UI patch contained a stub endpoint awaiting numerical calibration.
issues.fix: Added an endpoint that retrieves source candidates using local text/topic relevance. It generates no numerical percentage.
issues.verification: tests/matching.test.mjs; actual EXE returned 8 sources for oxygen 21; no 501.

issues.fix: Enter submits the form; Ctrl+Enter inserts a newline at the caret; IME composition is preserved.
issues.verification:
Actual EXE: a + CtrlEnter produced a
; Enter sent it to the user bubble.

issues.before: The eight-character minimum blocked short conversations.
issues.fix: Removed both minimum checks; reject only empty messages and retain the 1400-character maximum.

issues.before: Chat was unavailable without selected sources.
issues.cause: The UI required selected sources; a fixed findings schema was used.
issues.fix: /api/chat automatically selects local sources; conversation/no-evidence response types; context includes the last 8 messages.
issues.verification: HTTP mocks and no-preselection test; no live model call.

issues.before: The square icon and plus button in the tab strip were unwanted.
issues.fix: Removed the square and plus; comparison moved into Settings; compact tab strip.

issues.before: The early inline theme-loading script could be blocked by CSP.
issues.cause: Conflict between script-src self and an inline initializer.
issues.fix: Moved theme initialization into external app.js.
issues.verification: Inline script removed; header/theme present in the actual EXE.

issues.before: No calibration for numerical physical similarity.
issues.cause: Individual trial conditions and a validation set have not yet been normalized.
issues.fix: No percentage or critical-risk calculation was invented. The Relevant source label and limitation are explicit.
issues.verification: Null-similarity test; synthetic scores are not accepted in production.

issues.before: Not all document content was included in AI context.
issues.fix: Added hash-verified small CSV/TSV/TXT/MD excerpts; limits: 2 files per source, 12 KB and 6 sources. PDF/Excel content is still not read automatically.
issues.verification: Real CSV context test and corrupt-hash exclusion test.
